shortBulletSummary: Crypto markets are bleeding, with Bitcoin down 2.27% and Ethereum down 3.95% this week.
Bitcoin struggles around $80,000 following $810 million in weekend liquidations.
Federal Reserve is expected to hold interest rates, but a hotter-than-expected September CPI fuels future hike fears.
Ethereum hits a monthly low as the Glamsterdam upgrade faces delays and ETF outflows persist.
Middle East tensions and rising oil prices increase pressure on crypto markets.
